en: I never did like those two. Let's get moving.
I suppose that could work, if we had twenty people to cast it with.
Try the boar!  It's my new recipe!
Hello, my friends. It is good to see you again. Still keeping our borders free I see. Antonio appreciates your hard work.
Come with me if you want to live.

Once the capital city of the Dark Iron dwarves, this volcanic labyrinth now serves as the seat of power for Ragnaros the Firelord. Ragnaros has uncovered the secret to creating life from stone and plans to build an army of unstoppable golems to aid him in conquering the whole of Blackrock Mountain. Obsessed with defeating Nefarian and his draconic minions, Ragnaros will go to any extreme to achieve final victory.
Yer no warrior... Why ye wouldn't even last a day under my training regimen!  $B$BA $c who thinks $ghe's : she's; a warrior.  Ha!
Ye won't find any skinners out in here Dun Morogh $glad : lass;, they're mostly to be found in Ironforge if ye're looking to be trained.
5 seconds until detonation!!!!!
The Shattered Hand has been able to place spies throughout the upper citadel of Blackrock. Though the information gathering process has been slow, we have made discoveries that cannot be ignored.
There's a mage at the Thunderbrew Distillery who might be able to teach you some new spells.  I believe his name is Magis Sparkmantle.
Good to see you again, Amy. Be safe, luv. I'm off to Goldshire now.
What is going on here?  Leave that powder alone!
Face me, coward. Face the faith and strength that you once embodied.
A great evil stirs, $r. Can you feel it?$B$BBah! Of course you cannot. Hand me your armor and weapons and I shall renew their vigor.
How wonderful to see another person in this remote region of the world. Come, walk with me. Let our bodies keep each other warm.
A nice catch it is at that! You bring honor to the Horde boy, we thank you!
What plants are in Felwood that might be corrupted?
Welcome to the Tower of Azora, young $C.  I am Theocritus.$B$BDo you have business with me?  Or...do I have business with you, perhaps?
Who is this weak $R?  A foul intruder I say.  Die fool!
Oh, goody, something else to do while I wait! You're a real life-saver, $n!
I've seen you fight better den dat, Lana! You can gettem next time! Tark, get in there and giv'em hell!
They were just getting in the way anyways.
Who is the predictable one, beast? Surely you did not think that we would summon you on top of Malfurion? Your redemption comes, Eranikus. You will be cleansed of this madness - this corruption.
Do not summon me again unless you have a real question to ask, ok?

As we were making our way across the Burning Steppes, we were ambushed. It must have been a hundred of them... Dark Iron dwarves! They were shifting out of the walls, from the rocks in the Steppes; out of every crevice, nook, and cranny in sight. They swarmed us, overwhelming the guards and the few brave heroes that had agreed to assist us on this mission.$B$BOne thing was clear: This was a highly orchestrated ambush. It was as if they knew every move we would make before we made them...
And you did...
The war continued but the will of the great leader was sapped. The whole of Silithus was soon engulfed by the silithid and their Qiraji hosts.
Help!  Please, you must help me!
You will live forever in torment for this, pathetic warlock.

Hello there, $N.  I am known as Chronormu, but you may call me Chromie.  I am comfortable with such familiarity.$B$BNow - how did I know your name, you ask?  I am one of the bronze dragonflight, forever attuned to the ebb and flow of time.  You could say that we have met before.  To that end, we shall also meet again.$B$BI hope that my choice of visual demeanor does not disturb you; while I might be charged to be a sentry of sorrowful places, I choose not to drown in the sorrow of the locale.
I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.
